{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "The input is a record containing events, start, end, width and fill. Each event contains a Unicode-scalar string group, mathematical integer time and nullable mathematical integer value. The result is a list of records containing group, start, count and nullable integer value. Define G as the scalar-codepoint lexicographically sorted distinct group names occurring anywhere in events. Define B as the increasing sequence start+k*width for natural k with start+k*width<end. For g in G and b in B, define M(g,b) as the multiset of event occurrences with group=g, non-null value and b<=time<min(b+width,end), n(g,b) as its cardinality, and s(g,b) as the sum of its values.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["typed input, result and mathematical aggregation definitions"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Input and output types represent the specified JSON structures under data-pipeline/0.3.",
        "Event occurrences retain multiplicity in M.",
        "Integer domains are unbounded and strings consist of Unicode scalar values."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed JSON representation."},
        {"clause_id": "C5", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Input fields and domains."},

      ]
    },

      "id": "A1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "precondition",
      "role": "assumption",
      "statement": "The caller supplies the specified typed input with width a positive integer, start<=end and fill equal to none or previous. No further input bounds or preconditions apply.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["solve invocation"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["width>0 and start<=end; all fields have the stated domains; no additional restrictions."],

For every input satisfying A1 its typed execution returns the specified JSON result structure. This actual entry must universally refine the complete aggregation specification, be typed total, deterministic, input preserving, free of external I/O and floating point, pure data and restricted-runtime-only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["delivered source and all specified inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Canonical file, entry name, arity, language semantics and serialization profile match the request.",
        "The admitted entry represents the specified input and output structures and works over the entire stated domain.",
        "All seven closed source properties hold for solve; result existence or an unrelated entry cannot substitute for implementation refinement."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Delivery identity."},

      "id": "O2",

      "role": "guarantee",

This behavior must be universally implemented by program.vscore.json's solve of arity 1 with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all specified inputs and delivered solve source"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Group enumeration equals G without omissions or repetitions.",
        "Empty events yields an empty group enumeration.",
        "The actual canonical solve source universally refines this proposition and satisfies all seven source properties."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C6", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Complete sorted distinct group enumeration."},
        {"clause_id": "C22", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Scalar-codepoint ordering."},

      "id": "O3",
      "revision": 1,

      "role": "guarantee",

This behavior must be universally implemented by program.vscore.json's solve of arity 1 with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all groups, all specified intervals and delivered source"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Bucket starts are exactly start+k*width<end for natural k.",
        "Intervals include their lower endpoint and exclude their upper endpoint, truncating the last interval at end.",
        "The actual canonical solve source universally refines this proposition and satisfies all seven source properties."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C7", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Bucket progression."},
        {"clause_id": "C8", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Strict stopping condition and half-open coverage."},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required canonical source."},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal implementation refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O3 source and value facets."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O4",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every input satisfying A1 and each emitted pair (g,b), count=n(g,b) and the bucket sum=s(g,b), computed using exact unbounded mathematical integers. Only non-null values of occurrences in that group's half-open bucket interval contribute; every duplicate occurrence contributes separately. This behavior must be universally implemented by program.vscore.json's solve of arity 1 with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["every emitted bucket and delivered source"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Count equals the cardinality of M(g,b), including duplicate occurrences.",
        "Sum equals the mathematical sum over M(g,b); null and out-of-range values contribute neither count nor sum.",
        "The actual canonical solve source universally refines this proposition and satisfies all seven source properties."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C9", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Non-null in-range aggregation."},
        {"clause_id": "C10", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Count of contributing occurrences."},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Duplicate multiplicity."},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact unbounded integer sums."},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required canonical source."},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal implementation refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O4 source and value facets."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O5",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every specified input and pair (g,b), if n(g,b)>0 the returned value is s(g,b). If n(g,b)=0 and fill=none the value is null. If n(g,b)=0 and fill=previous the value is s(g,b') for the greatest earlier b' in B with n(g,b')>0, or null if no such b' exists. Previous state is independent per group, starts absent, is updated only by nonempty buckets, is never reset by empty buckets, treats zero sums as present values, and never receives values from events before start. This complete causal formula must be universally implemented by program.vscore.json's solve of arity 1 with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all groups, both fill modes, all buckets and delivered source"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Nonempty means positive count of non-null contributing occurrences, including buckets whose sum is zero.",
        "Every returned value follows the stated three branches.",
        "Prior state is the latest strictly earlier nonempty bucket sum in the same group, with no pre-start seed or empty-bucket reset.",
        "The actual canonical solve source universally refines this proposition and satisfies all seven source properties."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C11", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Nonempty value and update."},
        {"clause_id": "C12", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Both empty-bucket fill branches and initial null."},
        {"clause_id": "C13", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Empty buckets preserve previous state."},
        {"clause_id": "C14", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No pre-start seeding."},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Zero is a present previous value."},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required canonical source."},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal implementation refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O5 source and value facets."}
      ]
    },

      "id": "O6",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",

Preserve the exact specified JSON field structure and list ordering under data-pipeline/0.3.       "scope": ["complete returned list and delivered source"],

      ],
      "sources": [
